title: Request for draft shipping documents (no order data)
subject: Draft invoice and packing list – KT-0612
body:
Dear Karthik-san,

For our customs pre-registration, could you send a draft commercial invoice and packing list for KT-0612 by the end of next week? Carton dimensions and gross weights are especially important for us.

Best regards,
Haruka Mori
Kumo Textile Co., Ltd.
